summary: Induction on j with Laplace expansion along the first row.

steps.lean:
j.rec (by simp) fun _ k Z _ h ↦
  det_succ_row_zero' Z ▸ mem_ofSize_mono (S.sum_mem_ofSize (by simp; lia) fun _ ↦
  S.mul_mem_ofSize (i := 7) (by simp_all [neg_one_pow_eq_ite]) (k _ (by lia) (by tauto)))
steps.claim: Induction on the size j of the square matrix Z (with j ≤ ϱ and all entries in B^S_7): det Z ∈ B^S_{8j}.
j = 0: the determinant of the empty matrix is 1, and 1 ∈ B^S_0 = B^S_{8·0}.

steps.claim: j + 1 (with j + 1 ≤ ϱ, Z of size 7; k is the induction hypothesis for j): Laplace expansion along row 0 writes det Z = Σ_c (−1)^c Z_{0c} det Z^{(0,c)} as a sum of j + 1 ≤ r + 1 terms. Each (−1)^c Z_{0c} lies in B^S_7 (B^S_7 is closed under negation), each minor det Z^{(0,c)} lies in B^S_{8j} by k (it is a j×j matrix of size 7 and j ≤ ϱ), so each term lies in B^S_{7+8j}; by the sum axiom the sum lies in B^S_{8j+8} = B^S_{8(j+1)} (monotonicity for the bookkeeping).
